name: Kisaragi Suzuno
source:
Koharu's classmate and [url=/c1349]Shizuma[/url]'s younger sister. Has both brains and beauty, real "princess". Quite obedient most of the time but could be really strict and stubborn. Speaks only drawback and calls Natsuki "brother". Has a crush on [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url]. She teaches aikido in her families' dojo.

[Edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=31461]Getchu[/url]]
